The '''Cularin Government''' was the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The Cularin Government was a [[Army/Legends|military]] government controlled by the [[Thaereian military]] to govern the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="DC">{{LivingForce|Decision: Coruscant}}</ref> Around [[31 BBY]],<ref name="31 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The events of ''[[Shadows in Green]]'' can therefore be dated to about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] traveled to Cularin and was toured by many local people, and a rumor circulated among the visitors that the [[Wyrd]],<ref name="Shadows in Green">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}}</ref> a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Tarasin]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]],<ref name="APOD">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness}}</ref> were infiltrating the Cularin Government.<ref name="Shadows in Green" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some factions of the Cularin Government became concerned by the rapid mobilization of the [[Cularin Militia]], a nationalist armed force led founded by [[Osten Dal'Nay]].<ref name="FFAP">{{LivingForce|For Fun and Profit}}</ref> Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the Cularin Government was targeted by the anarchist group the [[Liana Liberators]], who [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the government's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems and illegally stole data.<ref name="The Replacements">{{LivingForce|The Replacements}}</ref> The Wyrd and the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] colluded to devise a plan to falsely implicate the Cularin Government and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as having had dealings with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and representatives of both groups met with the Confederacy to discuss how the scheme could be implemented.<ref name="DA">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>

Following a [[Cularin Question|debate]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the role of the [[Thaereian]] military on Cularin, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] awarded Cularin self-governance and expelled the Thaereian military from the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="DC" />
